process_area.title: COD Program Design, Policy & Risk Framework

value_stream.name: Cash-on-Delivery (COD) Operations, Driver Cash Handling & Reconciliation

fields.Owner: Head of Payment Operations / Ecommerce Finance / Commercial
fields.Trigger: Ecommerce growth (VS-10); payment-mix review; market/competitive pressure
fields.Volume: Enterprise COD program across ecommerce, MSME (VS-82), trade delivery (VS-74)

workflows.name: COD Program Strategy, Channel Scope & Operating Model

Automation Opportunity: - COD-share/cost scenario modeling; channel-segment profitability analytics
Controls: - CTL-656 (ensure controlled execution — COD Program Design, Policy & Risk Framework (PA-142.1).)
- CTL-656: strategy approved (CFO/COO); scope risk-tiered (W4266); cash-chain/handoffs documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (ecommerce), VS-80 (payment ops), VS-06.3/VS-56 (last-mile/3PL), VS-18 (treasury), VS-125 (fraud), W4266 (policy), W4272 (architecture)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Channel-mismatch risk**: COD offered where cost/fraud too high; mitigated by segment/geography scoping & risk-tier (W4266)
- **Chain-ambiguity risk**: Custody handoffs unclear → loss attribution disputes; mitigated by mapped cash-chain & handoff SLA
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce/order (VS-10); payment ops (VS-80); last-mile/3PL (VS-06.3/VS-56); treasury (VS-18); fraud (VS-125)

steps.activity: Payment Ops/Commercial set the COD strategy and channel scope (which channels/segments/geographies offer COD vs pre-pay only), the COD share target, and the operating model (own-crew collect vs 3PL-driver collect vs cash-handling partner)
Payment Ops/Last-Mile map the cash-chain design (driver → 3PL branch/depot → BuildRight → bank), the custody handoff points, and the reconciliation architecture (W4272), aligned to VS-06.3/VS-56
Payment Ops document the strategy, obtain approval, and cascade to policy (W4266), pricing (W4267), and 3PL terms (W4268)

fields.Volume: Eligibility/limit rules across the order base

workflows.name: COD Order Eligibility, Limit & Risk-Tier Policy

Automation Opportunity: - Risk-scoring → auto limit/auth; address/identity verification; dynamic blacklist; conversion-vs-loss optimization
Controls: - CTL-656: eligibility/limits risk-based (VS-125); high-risk pre-pay/auth; blacklist maintained
Cross-references: - links to VS-125 (fraud), VS-126 (CDP), VS-10 (order capture), VS-21.2 (risk), W4265 (strategy), W4287 (loss data)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-extension risk**: COD to high-risk buyers → refusal/fraud loss; mitigated by risk-tier limits & blacklist
- **Friction risk**: Limits too tight → lost legitimate sales; mitigated by tuning on conversion/loss data
System Touchpoints: - Fraud/rules engine (VS-125); CDP/customer signals (VS-126); order capture (VS-10); risk (VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Payment Ops/Fraud set COD eligibility (new vs returning, verified address, account age, blacklist) and per-order/per-customer COD value limits and item-type rules (no COD on ultra-high-value/DG) using fraud history (VS-125) and CDP signals (VS-126)
Payment Ops/Fraud define the risk-tier (low/med/high) with differentiated limits, authentication (OTP/address verification), and pre-pay nudge for high-risk; integrate to order capture (VS-10)
Fraud/Payment Ops tune limits on loss/refusal data (W4287), manage blacklists/whitelists, and monitor eligibility-policy performance

fields.Volume: COD fee/price structure across the catalog/segments

Automation Opportunity: - Cost-to-serve modeling; fee-vs-conversion A/B; RA leakage detection on COD charges
Controls: - CTL-656 (ensure controlled execution — COD Program Design, Policy & Risk Framework (PA-142.1).)
- CTL-656: COD fee cost-recovery-justified; RA-monitored (VS-118); incentives conversion-tested
Cross-references: - links to VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-118 (revenue assurance), VS-10 (ecommerce), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-14/VS-58 (marketing/promo), W4287 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-recovery risk**: COD fee below true cost-to-serve → margin leak; mitigated by cost-based fee & RA monitoring (VS-118)
- **Conversion risk**: Fee suppresses COD conversion; mitigated by A/B testing & incentive design
System Touchpoints: - Pricing/merchandising (VS-01.2); revenue assurance (VS-118); ecommerce (VS-10); finance (VS-17.4); marketing (VS-14/VS-58)

steps.activity: Pricing/Finance determine the COD cost-to-serve (handling, reconciliation, float/cost-of-capital, refusal/RTV cost, fraud loss) and set the COD fee (or pre-pay discount) to recover it, aligned to VS-118 pricing integrity
Pricing/Marketing set incentives (pre-pay nudge, e-wallet discount) to shift mix toward lower-cost payment (VS-80) without suppressing conversion, aligned to VS-14/VS-58
Revenue Assurance/Pricing monitor COD fee recovery vs actual COD cost (W4287), detect leakage (under-charge, override), and adjust

fields.Participants: Legal (VS-100.3), Finance (VS-17.4), HR (VS-98 for own crew), Insurance (VS-26), Fraud (VS-125)
fields.Volume: All drivers/3PLs authorized to collect COD cash

workflows.name: Driver/3PL COD Authorization, Bonding & Contract Terms

Automation Opportunity: - Driver-authorization registry with bonding/expiry tracking; auto-revoke on breach; exposure dashboards
Controls: - CTL-656 (ensure controlled execution — COD Program Design, Policy & Risk Framework (PA-142.1).)
- CTL-656: drivers authorized, trained (W4270) & bonded; contract liability explicit; insurance in place (VS-26)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (procurement), VS-56/VS-06.3 (3PL/last-mile), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-98 (own crew), VS-26 (insurance), VS-125 (fraud), W4270 (controls)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unbonded-driver risk**: Unauthorized/unbonded driver collects cash → theft exposure; mitigated by authorization + bonding gate
- **Liability-ambiguity risk**: 3PL vs BuildRight loss responsibility unclear; mitigated by explicit contract terms
System Touchpoints: - Procurement/contract (VS-34); legal (VS-100.3); 3PL mgmt (VS-56); HR/contingent (VS-98); insurance (VS-26); fraud (VS-125)
Time Estimate: - ~2–3 weeks per contract cycle; per-driver authorization ~1 day

steps.activity: Procurement/Legal embed COD cash-handling terms in 3PL contracts (cash custody responsibility, remittance SLA, bonding/security deposit, liability for loss/theft, audit rights) and in own-crew terms (coordinate VS-98)
Payment Ops/Last-Mile authorize specific drivers/crews to collect COD (ID, training on W4270 controls, fidelity bonding, daily cash limit per driver), and revoke on breach
Finance/Insurance structure bonding/insurance coverage (fidelity, cash-in-transit for the inward chain) via VS-26, and track exposure vs bonded limits

workflows.name: COD Risk Framework, Insurance & Loss-Account Policy

Automation Opportunity: - COD float-aging dashboards; loss-provision auto-suggestion; risk-register integration
Controls: - CTL-656: COD risks in ERM (VS-21.2); float/loss provisioned; insurance structured (VS-26); loss-reporting thresholds set
Cross-references: - links to VS-21.2 (ERM), VS-18 (treasury/float), VS-26 (insurance), VS-17.4/VS-17.1 (finance/GL), VS-125 (fraud), VS-90 (recovery), W4287 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unquantified-exposure risk**: COD float/loss not provisioned → earnings distortion; mitigated by float-aging & loss provisioning
- **Uninsured-loss risk**: Robbery/theft beyond coverage; mitigated by structured insurance (VS-26) & limits
System Touchpoints: - ERM/risk register (VS-21.2); treasury (VS-18); insurance (VS-26); finance/GL (VS-17.4/VS-17.1); fraud (VS-125); audit (VS-21)

steps.a: Head of Payment Ops / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Risk/Payment Ops identify COD risks (driver theft, customer refusal/short-pay, robbery in transit, fraud/phantom order, float/working-capital) and define mitigation/limits per risk, integrated to ERM (VS-21.2)

Treasury/Finance define the COD float/working-capital policy (cash-in-motion accounting, aging of unremitted COD, provisioning for refusal/loss) and the loss-account/treatment (write-off thresholds, recovery via VS-26/VS-90)

steps.a: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Insurance/Risk structure coverage (fidelity, cash-in-transit, robbery) via VS-26, define loss-reporting thresholds/escalation, and feed the risk register (VS-21.2)

fields.Volume: Cash-handling standard for all COD-collection staff

workflows.name: COD Cash-Handling Controls, SoD & Custody Standard

Automation Opportunity: - Digital POD with cash-amount capture; exception-based monitoring; SoD enforcement in workflow
Controls: - CTL-656: SoD (collect/reconcile/post segregated); daily remittance; tamper-evident custody; POD evidence; audit-monitored (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit), VS-125/VS-23 (fraud/exception), VS-06.3 (delivery app/POD), VS-98 (crew), W4268 (authorization), W4274 (collection)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Theft/skim risk**: Cash handled without control; mitigated by SoD, daily remittance, tamper-evident custody, proof capture
- **Evidence risk**: No proof of cash collected → unrecoverable dispute; mitigated by mandatory POD/cash-amount capture
System Touchpoints: - Audit/internal control (VS-21); fraud/exception (VS-125/VS-23); delivery app/POD (VS-06.3); finance (VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Payment Ops/Audit define the COD cash-handling standard (exact-change policy, receipt/POD capture, dual-control where feasible, daily remittance limit, tamper-evident bag, no-cash-overnight rule), with segregation of duties (collector ≠ reconciler ≠ poster)
Payment Ops train drivers/3PL/own crew on the standard (coordinate W4268 authorization & VS-98), and embed proof capture (POD + cash amount photo/digital) into the delivery app (VS-06.3)

steps.a: Head of Payment Ops / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Audit/Fraud monitor adherence (exception reports, spot checks, exception-based analytics VS-23/VS-125), investigate deviations, and enforce consequence

fields.Trigger: Risk framework (W4269); regulatory change; annual review

Automation Opportunity: - Cash-receipt serial/OR generation; large-cash threshold auto-flag; AML/CTR workflow integration
Controls: - CTL-656: COD revenue recognized at delivery (VS-79); cash-receipt BIR-compliant; large-cash thresholds monitored (VS-86)
Cross-references: - links to VS-79 (tax/BIR), VS-22 (compliance), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-18 (treasury), VS-86 (AML), VS-21 (audit), W4269 (risk)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Revenue-recognition risk**: COD revenue mis-timed → audit exposure; mitigated by clear recognition-at-delivery rule
- **Large-cash risk**: Undeclared large cash inflows; mitigated by thresholds & AML coordination (VS-86)
System Touchpoints: - Tax/BIR (VS-79); compliance/permits (VS-22); legal (VS-100.3); treasury (VS-18); AML (VS-86); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Tax/Compliance define the BIR treatment of COD sales (revenue recognition at delivery/collection, VAT per VS-79, official receipt/serial POS-equivalent for cash sales, cash-receipting compliance)

steps.a: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Treasury/AML define large-cash / structuring thresholds and any AML/CTR consideration for high-value COD cash inflows (coordinate VS-86/AMLC, VS-18)
Compliance/Legal document the framework, lodge any cash-handling/reporting requirements (VS-22), and schedule periodic compliance review/audit (VS-21)

Automation Opportunity: - End-to-end COD cash-status ledger; 3PL cash-file auto-ingest; GL auto-posting; real-time reconciliation
Controls: - CTL-656 (ensure controlled execution — COD Program Design, Policy & Risk Framework (PA-142.1).)
- CTL-656: architecture security-assessed (VS-27.3); data retained per policy (VS-88); cost governed (VS-135)
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (ecommerce), VS-06.3 (delivery), VS-56 (3PL), VS-18 (bank), VS-17.1 (GL), VS-125 (fraud), VS-27.3/VS-88/VS-135 (security/retention/TBM), VS-113 (EA)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-gap risk**: Cash-collected not linked to order → unreconcilable; mitigated by per-order cash-status ledger & end-to-end integration
- **Security/privacy risk**: Cash/PII data exposure; mitigated by security (VS-27.3) & retention (VS-88)
System Touchpoints: - Order/ecommerce (VS-10); delivery app (VS-06.3); 3PL (VS-56); bank/treasury (VS-18); GL (VS-17.1); fraud (VS-125); security (VS-27.3); TBM (VS-135); EA (VS-113)

steps.activity: Payment Ops/EA/IT design the COD data/integration architecture (order ↔ delivery/POD ↔ cash-collected ↔ remittance ↔ settlement ↔ GL), the cash-status ledger per order, and the 3PL data exchange (VS-56)
IT/Ecommerce implement & integrate (delivery app cash-capture VS-06.3, 3PL cash file, bank deposit feed VS-18, GL auto-posting VS-17.1, fraud rules VS-125), and govern data quality
IT/Payment Ops govern the platform lifecycle (roadmap, adoption, TBM cost VS-135, security VS-27.3, data retention VS-88), and optimize on analytics (W4287)
